description: This file defines and exports a plugin entry for the LiteLLM provider in an OpenClaw-based system. It configures provider metadata, authentication options, documentation paths, and provider catalog details.

methods.name: applyLitellmConfig
methods.description: Applies the LiteLLM configuration settings to the provided configuration object.

methods.name: buildLitellmProvider
methods.description: Constructs and returns a LiteLLM provider instance for the catalog.
